description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - a look-both-ways ritual verifier for crossing the street: at the curb you face the road and tap START to capture a reference heading; the agent then requires a 60-degree-plus head turn to each side, each held steady for one second (either order), before it announces that you looked both ways and logs the ritual. It verifies the head turns only - it cannot see cars, bikes or traffic lights, and it never declares a crossing safe
name: cross-street
